description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasIPC feature, specifically testing JSON encoding/decoding of the Request type related to canvas presentation, including roundtrip encoding and decoding with optional placement data.

classes.name: CanvasIPCTests
classes.description: A test suite for Canvas IPC-related functionality, specifically testing JSON serialization/deserialization of Request objects in different scenarios.

methods.name: canvas present codable roundtrip
